label: Nando's UK menu page Gatsby page-data JSON (nutritionalInfo.factsForPortionSizes per product)
notes: nandos.co.uk/food/menu is a Gatsby SPA whose HTML contains no macros (0 occurrences of 'protein'). The Gatsby data payload at /food/menu/page-data/index/page-data.json carries full per-item nutritionalInfo: energyKcal, proteinMg, fatMg, totalCarbsMg, saltMg, plus allergens and diet flags. 183 nutrition blocks, 148 unique product names with BOTH kcal and protein. Plausibility check protein*4 <= kcal*1.15 passed on all rows (0 violations). Protein converted mg -> g. Unauthenticated GET; the page-data path is Gatsby-build dependent, re-resolve from the menu page if it 404s.
